name: CareerMate AI Placement Knowledge Base
purpose: Editable baseline knowledge for placement preparation. Update this file without changing backend code.

topics.DSA: Study arrays, strings, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash maps, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, recursion, greedy algorithms and dynamic programming. Explain time and space complexity with Big-O and discuss trade-offs.
topics.Java: Core areas include OOP, interfaces and abstract classes, collections, generics, exceptions, streams, JVM/JRE/JDK, concurrency and testing.
topics.Python: Core areas include built-in data structures, functions, classes, exceptions, iterators, generators, decorators, virtual environments, testing and common standard-library tools.
topics.DBMS: Review relational models, keys, normalization, joins, indexes, transactions, ACID, isolation, constraints and query optimization.
topics.Operating Systems: Review processes vs threads, scheduling, memory management, virtual memory, deadlocks, synchronization, mutexes and semaphores.
topics.Computer Networks: Review OSI/TCP-IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP vs UDP, IP addressing, routing, TLS and client-server requests.
topics.AI and ML: Understand supervised and unsupervised learning, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, metrics, embeddings, LLM limitations and retrieval-augmented generation.
topics.Interview practice: Use STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for behavioural questions. Keep answers truthful, specific, concise and focused on the candidate's actual contribution.
topics.Resume: Prefer readable formatting, relevant skills, action verbs and measurable results only when those metrics are real and verifiable. Never invent credentials or achievements.
topics.Project explanation: Explain problem, users, architecture, technologies, your contribution, testing, limitations and next steps. Clearly distinguish completed features from planned features.
